semiconductor_relevance: High — Tulip specializes in precision needle technology for printed circuit board inspection, which is critical in semiconductor testing.
summary: Tulip Co., Ltd. is a manufacturer of advanced needle technology, focusing on precision needles used in printed circuit board inspection. With a rich history in needle-making, the company has evolved to meet the diverse demands of the electronics industry, ensuring high-quality products for semiconductor testing applications.
capabilities: Precision needles for printed circuit board inspection
Advanced needle technology for probing applications
Custom probe cards and DUT boards
technical_expertise: Inspection and testing methodologies for electronics

regional_presence.Japan: Tulip is based in Hiroshima, Japan, leveraging a long-standing tradition in needle manufacturing.
